title: Papery-neck Garlic Bulb
description: One newly authored static low-poly garlic-bulb appearance: seven uneven tapered and curved full clove volumes around a continuous narrowed papery neck and a natural cut basal root disc. Every clove is a full solid volume, not a groove painted on a recolored pumpkin. Nine editable closed meshes and three opaque matte PBR materials. Metres, Z up, true whole horizontal bounds centre and basal disc at Z0. Static crop appearance only, not a biological growth simulation, exact cultivar or food/cultivation advice.
